title: Chicken Fajita Quesadilla
reject_reason: Chicken fajita filling (chili/cumin chicken + peppers/onion) folded in tortillas with cheese is the same fajita-chicken identity as live creamy-chicken-fajita-burrito; quesadilla vs burrito is a format nuance and Tex-Mex chicken is already crowded (fajita burrito + fajita rice bowl live).
